source_en: Booster mode: Standard. Only boosters cross-checked against two external sources for the card's built-in effect, plus manager corrections, are reflected in these totals (not confirmed by KONAMI). Includes effects assumed to be fixed-type and Power of Many (applied provisionally since there is no concrete evidence either way). Excludes gold variable boosters (whose effect scales with same-league player count in a Game Plan and cannot be auto-evaluated for the current squad), user-specified values, effects still under verification, and unresolved bundled boosters or manual estimates.
draft: Güçlendirici modu: Standart. Bu toplamlara yalnızca kartın yerleşik etkisi için iki harici kaynakla çapraz kontrol edilmiş güçlendiriciler ve teknik direktör düzeltmeleri yansıtılır (KONAMI tarafından doğrulanmamıştır). Sabit tür olduğu varsayılan etkileri ve Power of Many'yi içerir (her iki yönde de somut kanıt olmadığı için geçici olarak uygulanır). Altın değişken güçlendiriciler (etkisi bir Game Plan'daki aynı lig oyuncu sayısıyla ölçeklenir ve mevcut kadro için otomatik değerlendirilemez), kullanıcının belirlediği değerler, hâlâ doğrulanmakta olan etkiler ve çözümlenmemiş paket güçlendiriciler ya da manuel tahminler hariçtir.

source_en: Some players have a manually specified application stage for gold/variable boosters. source_en: An exact-match candidate is a saved build where the World ID (worldCardId), rulesVersion, progression allocation, player booster estimate, and Power of Many specification all match (even if the build name, buildId, created time, or updated time differ, it's still treated as a match).

source_en: Applies only boosters whose changes were confirmed directly from saved screenshots. This does not mean they were confirmed on KONAMI's official game screens. source_en: In addition to the above, applies boosters whose effects match across two external sources (eFootball World and EFScout) with no counterexamples across multiple cards. These are not values confirmed as KONAMI's official calculation results. The criterion for applying is cross-checking the effect, regardless of activation type. Boosters lacking evidence of their activation type are provisionally applied as fixed, since there is no concrete evidence that they are Power of Many (conditional) ("externally cross-checked; includes fixed-type estimates").
